meta.title: SkillUp Languages — learn languages the fun way
meta.description: SkillUp Languages — bright apps for learning German, Spanish and Polish on Android, iOS and the web.

hero.lead: German, Spanish and Polish — in apps for Android, iOS and right in your browser. Short lessons, games and cheerful Globi, who won’t let you give up.

catalog.title: Which language will you learn?
catalog.subtitle: Tap a language — we’ll show all its apps for Android, iOS and the web.

features.title: Learning that’s easy and fun
features.subtitle: We did everything to make a language your favorite habit, not a boring chore.

games.title: Games, not cramming
games.text: Words and grammar stick through mini-games, quizzes and challenges.

minutes.title: 5 minutes a day
minutes.text: Short lessons fit easily into your commute, lunch or break.

speech.title: Real pronunciation
speech.text: Native speaker audio and a speaking trainer with hints.

streaks.title: Streaks and rewards
streaks.text: Globi keeps track of your streak and gives bonuses for persistence.

anywhere.title: Always with you
anywhere.text: Android, iOS and web — your progress syncs across devices.

levels.title: Levels A1–B2
levels.text: The course follows the European CEFR scale — from zero to fluency.

how.title: Three steps to your first «Hallo!»
how.subtitle: No complicated sign-ups — you can start in a minute.

choose.title: Pick a language
choose.text: German, Spanish or Polish — whatever fits your goal.

download.title: Download the app
download.text: Android, iOS or web — whatever suits you.

grow.title: Practice and grow
grow.text: Take a level test and earn rewards every day.

reviews.title: Learners love us
reviews.subtitle: Thousands of people already speak a new language. You’re next!

cta.title: Ready to speak a new language?
cta.text: Download the app for Android or iOS and try it {trial}. Short lessons every day — and Globi will make sure you don’t quit.

footer.about: Bright apps for learning languages. Learn the fun way — a little every day.
